references.title: DWDS: Poster
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung for 1Poster, das, '(künstlerisch gestaltetes) Plakat zu Dekorationszwecken'; the Etymologie: übernommen (1960s) von gleichbed. engl. poster, a formation on English to post

notes.rationale: The wall poster, das Poster, is a loan from English poster with no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word with no Constituents: the Root poster and the zero ending (ADR 0050: a loan blended abroad has none; ADR 0051). Neither Post nor posten is inside it in German. der Poster, someone who posts in a forum, splits posten + -er and is another Lemma, DWDS's 2Poster, a headword with its own sense. Duden and DWDS give das Poster, also der, in one sense, so its Core gender is mixed Masc and Neut (de/noun-gender-in-free-variation; the round-5 judges agreed on #1241).
